title: 第23章 灵石零食第24章 战金丹三层
slug: 穿越修真界开局娶了美女大师姐
lines: 莫凡刚才突破境界之后太兴奋，灵石忘了收起来，现在才发现灵石已经消失。
打开灵兽袋，小白正在呼呼大睡，灵石应该不是它吃的。
那么，灵石到哪去了呢？
“别找了，被我吃了。”一道声音突然在莫凡的识海中响起。
“谁？”莫凡吓了一跳，四下张望。
“嗡！”手指上的神秘戒指震动了一下。
莫凡将戒指举到眼前，问道：“灵石被你吃了？”
“对，好久没吃灵石了，那味道想念得紧。”那道声音又在莫凡识海里出现，听起来懒洋洋的。
“你会说话？”
“废话，难道我现在在和你放屁吗？”
“那你以前干嘛一直不说，现在突然开口了？”
“我的力量用完了，沉睡了不知道多久。吃了那两枚灵石，才让我恢复一点点力气。”这句话说得有点有气无力。
“你要吃多少灵石才能恢复？”莫凡问道。
“大概几十万枚极品灵石吧。”
“几十万？还极品灵石？你当是豆子呢。”莫凡差点要跳起来。青荻前辈的戒指里都没有极品灵石呢。
不过，莫凡还是从青荻前辈的戒指里取出一百枚上品灵石。
“看不出来你小子还挺大方的，我没看错你。”识海里那道声音刚说完，地上的一百枚灵石瞬间被神秘戒指吸收。
一百枚上品灵石啊！莫凡心痛不已。自己做的什么孽，身边尽是拿灵石当零食吃的，小白，还有这神秘戒指。
“看你那一副便秘的模样，有我在，以后灵石你要多少有多少。”神秘戒指不屑地说。
虽然心痛，莫凡还是又拿出一百枚上品灵石。毕竟，是这神秘戒指带着自己穿越到这玄武大陆，又带着自己走上修真之路。
一百枚灵石又被神秘戒指瞬间吸收。
“嗝！”一个打嗝声在莫凡识海响起。
“行了，小子够意思，先吃这么多，我要慢慢恢复，不能一下吃太多。”戒指的声音中气足了很多。
“前辈，你是这戒指的器灵吗？”莫凡用神识跟神秘戒指交流。
“我不是器灵，戒指就是我，我就是戒指。”戒指回答道。
“那前辈来自哪里，为何会出现在地球？”
“我也不记得了，我应该是受过很严重的伤，记忆里缺少了很多东西。我来自哪里，为何会出现在你所说的地球，我一点印象都没有。”
“那么前辈，你除了能完善功法、武技，寻找宝物外，还有什么别的能力吗？”莫凡继续问道。
“呵呵，这个嘛，以后你就知道了。我只记得，没有受伤时候的我能耐大了去。”戒指故作神秘。
莫凡不再多问，他把封住洞穴的泥土推开，走了出去。
此时，洞穴外围着十来个人，他们身着统一的服饰，王浩正是其中一人。
看来王浩找到归元宗的帮手，来找莫凡算账了。
“哦，原来是王浩，归元宗的小乌龟，来找我报仇？”莫凡斜视着王浩。
content_en:
Mo Fan was so excited after breaking through the realm just now that he forgot to put the spirit stone away, and now he realized that the spirit stone had disappeared.
Opening the spirit beast bag, Xiaobai was sleeping soundly. The spirit stone should not be eaten by it.
So, where did the spirit stone go?
"Stop looking for it, you'll be eaten by me." A voice suddenly sounded in Mo Fan's sea of ​​consciousness.
"Who?" Mo Fan was startled and looked around.
"Buzz!" The mysterious ring on his finger vibrated.
Mo Fan raised the ring to his eyes and asked, "Did you eat the spirit stone?"
"Yes, I haven't eaten spirit stones for a long time. I miss the taste so much." The voice appeared again in Mo Fan's sea of consciousness, sounding lazy.
"Can you talk?"
"Nonsense, am I farting with you now?"
"Then why did you never say anything before and now you suddenly speak up?"
"I ran out of power and fell asleep for an unknown amount of time. After eating those two spiritual stones, I regained a little strength." This sentence was said a little weakly.
"How many spirit stones do you need to eat to recover?" Mo Fan asked.
"Probably hundreds of thousands of top-quality spiritual stones."
"Hundreds of thousands? The best spiritual stone? You think it's just a fool." Mo Fan almost jumped up. There are no top-quality spiritual stones in Senior Qingdi’s ring.
However, Mo Fan still took out a hundred high-grade spiritual stones from Senior Qingdi's ring.
"I can't tell you are quite generous. I saw you right." As soon as the voice in the sea of ​​consciousness finished speaking, a hundred spirit stones on the ground were instantly absorbed by the mysterious ring.
One hundred high-grade spiritual stones! Mo Fan was heartbroken. What evil had he done? He was surrounded by people who used spirit stones as snacks, Xiaobai, and this mysterious ring.
"Look at your constipated look. As long as I'm here, you can have as many spiritual stones as you want from now on." The mysterious ring said disdainfully.
Although he was heartbroken, Mo Fan still took out another hundred high-grade spiritual stones. After all, it was this mysterious ring that took him across the Xuanwu Continent and took him on the path of cultivation.
One hundred spirit stones were instantly absorbed by the mysterious ring.
"Hiccup!" A hiccup sounded in Mo Fan's sea of ​​consciousness.
"Okay, kid, that's cool. Eat this much first. I want to recover slowly. I can't eat too much at once." Ring's voice was much more energetic.
"Senior, are you the weapon spirit of this ring?" Mo Fan used his spiritual consciousness to communicate with the mysterious ring.
"I am not a weapon spirit. The ring is me. I am the ring." The ring replied.
"Then where did the senior come from and why did he appear on Earth?"
"I don't remember either. I must have been seriously injured and a lot of things are missing from my memory. Where I came from and why I appeared on the earth you mentioned, I have no memory at all."
"Senior, besides perfecting your martial arts, martial arts, and finding treasures, do you have any other abilities?" Mo Fan continued to ask.
"Haha, you will know this later. I only remember that I was more capable when I was not injured." The ring pretended to be mysterious.
Mo Fan didn't ask any more questions. He pushed away the soil that sealed the cave and walked out.
At this time, there were about ten people outside the cave, wearing uniform clothes, and Wang Hao was one of them.
It seems that Wang Hao found helpers from Guiyuan Sect and came to Mo Fan to settle the score.
"Oh, it turns out it's Wang Hao, the little turtle of Guiyuan Sect, who came to take revenge on me?" Mo Fan squinted at Wang Hao.
